Answer: B
Reason: The yellow arrows in Figure 3a point to radiolucent streaks in the supraclavicular soft tissues, which represent subcutaneous emphysema. This finding indicates that air has dissected from the mediastinum along fascial planes into the neck and chest wall, a hallmark sign of spontaneous pneumomediastinum often resulting from alveolar rupture (Macklin effect).
